items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Also, he called Milt Hinton on bass, the date was Dinah Washington record date... he hired Jimmy Crawford and Milt Hinton to make a record date with him

ctx.x: Who were some of your favorite bass players that you liked to play with?

Well, Milt Hinton, number one. And Oscar Pettiford. Of course, he was playing a bass like a violin player. But, I mean, he was just great execution-wise. And then you had -- oh, so many good bass players. But you still could put them on -- count them on your hands, on your fingers. Milt Hinton, oh, man.
What about Jimmy Blanton? What did you think of him?
